subject: [TRAE] Meet the New SOLO (Beta Early Access)
body_text:
Introducing The New SOLO
Dear TRAE User,
On March 31, we launched the new
TRAE
SOLO (beta)
, a standalone AI agent designed for everyone in the product development lifecycle.
Developers, product managers, data scientists, designers, marketers, operations teams, everyone in the professional workspace can leverage SOLO to handle their tasks.
With SOLO, you define the task, review the results, and SOLO handles the execution, turning your files and context into structured, professional deliverables.
What's New in SOLO
- Code Mode:
a focused, chat-driven coding experience where SOLO writes, runs, and iterates on code
- MTC (More Than Coding) Mode:
handles
professional tasks like creating documents, analyzing datasets, generating reports, building presentations, and conducting research from a single workspace
- Desktop and Web:
work with local files on Desktop, or run tasks in the cloud via Web
Beta
Early Access
- SOLO is
free
during the beta early access phase. An
invite code
is required
-
TRAE
Ultra users
do not need a code as beta early access is included in the plan
-
Invite codes are available through
social media giveaways
,
community events
and
TRAE IDE drops
Take a Deep Dive
SOLO is now available on Desktop and Web.
Take a deeper dive into the full launch blog which includes best practices and role based scenarios that show how SOLO helps you move from ideas to professional deliverables, faster.
Explore SOLO Now
Have a great time exploring SOLO!
The TRAE Team
